english.title: Furnish false information in purported compliance with a section 9 notice
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in furnishing information in compliance with a notice made by the Office of Fair Trading under section 9 of the Estate Agents Act 1979 made a statement which you knew to be false in a material particular or recklessly made a statement which was false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSIFICATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(4)(b) of the Estate Agents Act 1979.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
